newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London end flat in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London end flat in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London ended broadly flat on Monday after hovering in a narrow range for most of the session, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index eased 1.81 points to close at 11,566.09 after hovering in a range which extended from a low of 11,555.01 to a high of 11,567.83.
"I opened my prices at 9.30 am (0830 GMT) and since then I haven't changed them," said one trader.
"Everyone is long, they've got the positions they want and there's no real significant data out in the U.S. this week," said one trader in London.
On Friday, the Hang Seng London Reference index soared to close 150.94 points higher, spurred on by a surge in U.S. bonds and equities after U.S. data eased fears of a possible interest rate rise.
In Hong Kong on Monday, the Hang Seng index closed 198.86 points higher at 11,567.90.
"Hong Kong basically traded up to where prices were in London on Friday," said one trader.
Traders said there was little on the agenda for this week but they would keep an eye on U.S. industrial production and capacity utilisation data due on Tuesday.
